info.title: API.SH: Fincaraiz
info.description: The Fincaraiz API from API.SH: public Fincaraiz data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A real-estate agency or developer on Fincaraíz: name, type, description, address, logo, profile link, offices with their email, then its listings (newest first, same fields as search). Pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fincaraiz-agency

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Agency id (from a listing's advertiser) or its link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Places on Fincaraíz matching a name (cities, zones, localities, neighbourhoods), with id, type, city, zone and coordinates, for `location_id` and `location_type` in search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fincaraiz-locations

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Colombian property listings for sale or rent from Fincaraíz with every filter the site offers: place (any city, zone, locality or neighbourhood by name, or a `location_id` from /fincaraiz/v1/locations), property types, keywords, price (COP or USD), price per m², bedrooms, bathrooms, rooms, parking spaces, stratum, surface (built or total), floor, amenities, new or used, disposition, publication age, private owners only, social housing (VIS), projects, 3D tours, one agency's listings, and sort. Each listing has title, description, price, admin fee, USD price, bedrooms, bathrooms, parking, floor, stratum, areas, age, condition, address and coordinates, the place hierarchy, amenities, technical sheet, photos and the advertiser (agencies by name; private owners with the name the site shows, no phone or address), plus `raw`. 21 a page; pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fincaraiz-search

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated types or ids: house, apartment, studio, cabin, country_house, house_lot, farm, room, lot, warehouse, consulting_room, shop, office, parking, building.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A place name, e.g. `chapinero`, `medellin`, `el poblado` (the best match is used; `location` in the answer shows which).

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: A place id from /fincaraiz/v1/locations (with `location_type`), instead of `location`.

parameters.name: location_type
parameters.description: The place type that goes with `location_id`: city, zone, locality, neighbourhood, state.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of price_min/price_max: COP (default) or USD.

parameters.name: bedrooms
parameters.description: Bedrooms, comma separated, e.g. `2,3` (4 means 4 or more).

parameters.name: area_type
parameters.description: Which surface area_min/area_max use: built (default) or total.

parameters.name: floor
parameters.description: Floor bands, comma separated: 0 ground floor, 1 floors 2-5, 2 floors 6-10, 3 above 10, 4 penthouse.

parameters.name: agency_id
parameters.description: Only this agency's listings (id from a listing's advertiser or /fincaraiz/v1/agency).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
